==Copyright==
Please note that you are not allowed to copy in text from other websites to this wiki. The content ''must'' be your own and not taken from encyclopaedia-wot.org or other sites. If you have used content from other sites, please ensure that is removed as soon as possible. [[w:User:Angela|Angela]] <sup>[[User talk:Angela|talk]]</sup> 18:10, 14 March 2007 (UTC)

:I'm aware of this wiki's status under the GFDL, and that of other websites that are outside of it, so I was particularly surprised to see the two chapter summaries to which I made the primary, if not sole, contributions deleted - one for ''potential'' copyvio, the other without reason. For the record, both of these summaries contained entirely original content. I understand your position outside of the WOT wiki and that you may not be familiar with the source material, but surely this is more reason not to unilaterally delete articles? [[User:Aristoc|Aristoc]] 17:46, 15 March 2007 (UTC)
